name: What are the advantages of buying a new construction condo versus a pre-owned one?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of buying a new construction condo versus a pre-owned one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buying a new construction condo offers advantages such as modern designs, updated building codes, energy-efficient appliances, and the ability to customize finishes and upgrades before completion. You also benefit from brand-new systems and a builder's warranty, reducing immediate maintenance concerns. However, new construction might involve a longer waiting period and potentially higher prices than comparable resale units. Considerations for customization, amenities, and project timelines are key factors in weighing these options.
acceptedAnswer.description: New construction condos offer modern designs, energy efficiency, customization options, and builder warranties. They may involve longer waiting periods and potentially higher costs compared to pre-owned units.
